Walk it

Before you start

  • You need the released order from step 4.2 (Release the order).

Values

FieldValueStep
To Date/TimeThe day after the production start5.3
Materials shipped2 BAM-ROD and 1 BAM-SLEEVE

Steps

Screen
Manufacturing➔Job Shop➔Production Orders (tisfc0501m000)

Why LN works this way. The issue order waits until you start the issue. Starting it opens the issue order's lines, and shipping them takes the materials out of their warehouse. The first material shipped makes the order Active; release alone doesn't.

StepActionYou should see
5.1Open Production Orders and tick the order
5.2Choose Actions➔Materials➔Initiate Inventory Issue…Initiate Inventory Issue opens
5.3In To Date/Time, pick a day after the order's production start with the calendarExampleTo Date/Time The day after the production startThe date changes
5.4Click Initiate, then ContinueProcess completed. in the status bar. The dialog stays open
5.5Click Close, and on Production Orders choose Actions➔Materials➔Material to Issue for Production OrdersOne line per component. To Issue by Warehouse = its estimated quantity
5.6Tick a line and choose References➔Warehouse OrdersWarehousing Orders. The issue order reads Open
5.7On the issue order's row, click Drill InWarehousing Order, with one outbound line per component, each Open
5.8On the Outbound Lines tab, tick every line and choose Actions➔Advice➔Generate AdviceEach line reads Advised
5.9Tick every line again and choose Actions➔Advice➔Release AdviceEach line, and the order, reads Shipped
5.10Go back to Material to Issue for Production Orders and click RefreshActual Quantity = the estimated quantity, To Issue by Warehouse = 0. The order reads Active

If something goes wrong

SymptomWhat to do
To Issue by Warehouse stays 0 after step 5.4To Date/Time may be before the materials are due. Run step 5.2 again with a later date
The issue stops short and a shortage report printsA component is short and negative stock isn't allowed. The quantity waits in To Issue by Warehouse; restock it, then go on from step 5.6
A Loading badge stays over the lines' Actions buttonClick Refresh on the Outbound Lines toolbar
Lines are already Advised or ShippedThe material is set to process by itself. Go on to step 5.10

Production order
Issue material to the job shop

  1. This task starts at Manufacturing➔Job Shop➔Production Orders (tisfc0501m000)

    Open Production Orders and tick the order

    Your values
    Production order number · 2.6Write it down at step 2.6

  2. Choose Initiate Inventory Issue…

    Actions➔Materials➔Initiate Inventory Issue…

    You should see

    Initiate Inventory Issue opens

  3. In To Date/Time, pick a day after the order's production start with the calendar

    Example
    To Date/Time The day after the production start
    You should see

    The date changes

  4. Click Initiate, then Continue

    You should see

    Process completed. in the status bar. The dialog stays open

  5. Click Close, and on Production Orders choose Material to Issue for Production Orders

    Actions➔Materials➔Material to Issue for Production Orders

    You should see

    One line per component. To Issue by Warehouse = its estimated quantity

  6. Tick a line and choose Warehouse Orders

    References➔Warehouse Orders

    You should see

    Warehousing Orders. The issue order reads Open

  7. On the issue order's row, click Drill In

    You should see

    Warehousing Order, with one outbound line per component, each Open

  8. On the Outbound Lines tab, tick every line and choose Generate Advice

    Actions➔Advice➔Generate Advice

    You should see

    Each line reads Advised

  9. Tick every line again and choose Release Advice

    Actions➔Advice➔Release Advice

    You should see

    Each line, and the order, reads Shipped

  10. Go back to Material to Issue for Production Orders and click Refresh

    You should see

    Actual Quantity = the estimated quantity, To Issue by Warehouse = 0. The order reads Active

  • Kept in this browser until you start a new run.

    • To Issue by Warehouse stays 0 after step 4

      To Date/Time may be before the materials are due. Run step 2 again with a later date

    • The issue stops short and a shortage report prints

      A component is short and negative stock isn't allowed. The quantity waits in To Issue by Warehouse; restock it, then go on from step 6

    • A Loading badge stays over the lines' Actions button

      Click Refresh on the Outbound Lines toolbar

    • Lines are already Advised or Shipped

      The material is set to process by itself. Go on to step 10

  • The issue order waits until you start the issue. Starting it opens the issue order's lines, and shipping them takes the materials out of their warehouse. The first material shipped makes the order Active; release alone doesn't.
